## MediaForge Timeline — LTX-2 (experimental, video-only carry)

1. Pick the LTX-2 checkpoint, the distilled LoRA and the Gemma text encoder (the same checkpoint feeds the text-encoder and audio-VAE loaders).
2. ⏱️ Edit Timeline uses fps 25 and the `causal_8n+1` grid (lengths 8n+1). 🧬 Extend Latent needs `experimental_causal = on`; only the video stream is carried.
3. Audio of each segment is decoded by core **LTXVAudioVAEDecode** (24 kHz) and wired into ➕ Append Segment `audio`.

Default plan: 2 × 97 frames, overlap 17 → **177 frames**. Keep a single sampler pass per segment.
